notes.title: New Build 1.19!
notes.notes:
Hey girl dudes and guy dudes. Just wanted to drop a line that thanks to the awesome efforts of the Greenworks team, Scirra team and LIL OL ME i managed to get the game updated to a much more recent version of Node Webkit, using a much more recent version of Construct 2, and a much more recent version of the Steamworks API.

What does this mean exactly? Well, it should fix a butt tonne of engine bugs that i personally had no chance of fixing cuz well they were in the engine. I was running a much older version of Construct 2 for building (r216) but with the recent changes I was able to upgrade to r233 which has a plethora of issues resolved. It also means im using a more recent version of Node Webkit which blah blah blah sounds super boring but it should help with keeping things running smoother, and im actually hoping it resolves an issue with garbled text on certain high resolution / high dpi windows machines. (let me know).

Overall, things should be better.. but it does give me some new hope for a feature so many people have been axin' for since day effin one. We'll see... I feel like there's a chance it can come to fruition... a chance.... just a chance...

Almost forgot - this new update also means there is now support for 64bit Windows and MacOS versions. Previously I could only support 64bit on linux but EFF THAT NOISE. Now we can all share in the futuristic bit glory. 

Hope you're enjoying the game ;) 

Hugs,
N8:mushbloom:

Hey pals, I have posted a new beta build (look at the properties for Cosmochoria in your steam library then opt into the Beta Testing branches to view.)

- German
- Russian
- Spanish

Hugs to all!

notes.title: Update 1.13.13 - A Compromise.
notes.notes:
I'm a reasonable guy. I try to take feedback given to me with as much of a rational open minded viewpoint as possible. I try to be aware of the impact my decisions and actions make on the world, even the small stupid ones, and I try to make up for them with hopefully less stupid decisions and actions.

Yesterday was a big deal for me. While I'm not a die hard fan of pewdiepie, I've heard of his legacy. Like a gold armoured knight riding through the kingdoms, he looks down from his mighty steed and smiles at a small orphan girl, and as he rides away, the townspeople all flock to the orphan girl and ask her what her name is and if they can be her friend. Only its nothing like that at all, but in the heat of the moment, with emotions and excitement on such a large exposure to my work taking place right before my eyes, I got caught up in it all. 

Yesterday I made a silly update to Cosmochoria which put a cartoon rendition of a naked, grinning pewdiepie in the game. Many people reached out to me to say this was funny / enjoyed / smart, etc but some reached out to calmly, or otherwise, tell me that they were dissatisfied with my decision and that it ruined the game for them.

It would be short sighted and selfish to think that they have no right to feel this way and that this, being my work of expression (or ridiculous nonsense), that I can do whatever I want with it. But the truth is, Cosmochoria is the end result of not only my own ideas but countless countless others. From the moment I shared it with close family and friends, to the kickstarter campaign, then all throughout early access with live streams and regular content updates, I've held the opinions and feedback of so many amazing people as words of gold, and have done my very very best to incorporate those ideas and make those changes where I thought the game would most benefit. It would be foolish of me to turn my back on that philosophy now.

I have made some tweaks to Cosmochoria. I'm not going to program in a feature like enabling / disabling the halloween content because in 2 weeks the halloween content will be gone and no one will even think about it anymore. As a compromise, I've restored the sprite of the default Cosmo costume so that if you use it, you are getting the original artwork for cosmo. Now the only things that are halloween-related are the additional costumes, which will unlock as you play and become more familiar with the game, the UFO's which lets face it are just as fun to blow up as pumpkins, and the various planets and planetary objects found scattered throughout the galaxy, which really dont do anything to take away from what the game offers, and I was even considering leaving that stuff in after halloween since it's pretty cool regardless.

As for Pewdiepie. I'm not taking him out because I think he fits perfectly with what the game is supposed to be: a reflection of me and my thoughts. The story of cosmochoria will make that more clear as you get into the game and realize it's not 'just' an arcade game... Just as much as I added nipples to cosmo on a whim, and designed a giant mothership as a boss because my then 4 year old wanted me to, i put a sprite of a pewdiepie clone in the mix because thats what this game is: absurd, nonsensical, but all in all me & my creation. I made pewdiepie clones appear much more rarely now so you should see him much much much less frequently, but if you truly feel the pdp clone breaks the immersion by being in the game, then a) you have one more reason to destroy it, and b) you need to read some more hologram pods.

Im sorry if I turned you off the game with these recent graphical decisions, and I'm honoured that you felt so strongly about it that you needed to express yourself. I just wanted to say that I was and always will be listening and will always try to find compromises between what your vision is for this game and my own.

Peace,
Nate

PS Changes are now live.

notes.title: NEW UPDATE! 1.07 - Balance, Visuals & Achievements
notes.notes:
Hey Dudes (brudes (bro dudes) and gudes (girl dudes))!!!

First and foremost I wanted to give you all a HUGE THANK YOU for your support of Cosmochoria. I am blown away at the great response and kind, positive reviews you've left me. Im so happy that you enjoy the game and want to do my best to bring new updates and improvements to give you a reason to keep playing :) 

It's been a while since the last update, but I've had my hands full with some of the more major things, including the re-bindable keys and a secret update Im hoping to get done within the coming months. Shh. its a secret to everybody.

Anyway, I wanted to post this update as it has some pretty cool stuff, especially considering it should resolve some of the more obscure bugs that have plagued a few people. The biggest change you might notice if you play Cosmochoria EVERY FREAKING DAY is that there have been some fairly major balance changes, ultimately making it a little bit easier especially in early game. I think some of the hardcoreness was quite off putting and thanks to the steam reviews i was able to see from a few people that the extreme difficulty of the game has severely impacted their ability to enjoy it. hopefully i fixed that to some extent. 

Anyway, I don't think it's a super huge deal because:
a) It still gets pretty hard, pretty quick as you start saving planets and the enemy count gets more and more hectic.
b) Bosses should be roughly the same difficulty with maybe a bit of a slight difference with the weapon strength. 

Overall, I still think the game is extremely fun and I would actually say the difficulty tweaks have made it even more fun if you were already digging it. It just... feels better.... I hope you like!

Also there's a huge handful of new achievements. If you've met the criteria for the achievements already, they should just unlock once you get to the title screen, really.

Here's a full changelog of what's in the update. Id love to hear what you think!

Hugs,
nate

Changelog for 1.07
-----
[list]
[*] ACHIEVEMENTS: 12 New Steam Achievements :)

notes.title: FULL v1.0 LAUNCH ON MONDAY!
notes.notes:
I am [b]so[/b] proud and excited to announce that Cosmochoria will be launching out of Early Access and into a full Steam release on Monday, April 27 at about 9am PST. 

I wanted to take a second to both thank and congratulate every single one of you who have a copy of Cosmochoria in your Steam Libraries right now. Whether you purchased the Early Access version, or are one of the incredible backers from the Cosmochoria Kickstarter campaign which ended just over a year ago, you have all my juicy loves.

Cosmochoria started as a seed and I always knew what that seed could one day become and I can honestly say that not only did you help that seed sprout, but so many of you personally touched my heart and mind throughout the process of creating this game—shaping it beyond even my own imagination. Thank you so much for having my back. You made my dream come true this past year, and I will never, ever forget that. 

Sincerely & with a hug that lasts until infinity,
Nate Schmold

notes.notes:
This is getting heavy dudes.

We now essentially have all the functionality that will be in the final build of Cosmochoria. I'm worried there might be some weird bugs because so much core stuff was tweaked and added here, but its awesome so have a look and let me know what you think.

Some KEY Things:

[b]Super Mysterious Ultra Dimensional Time Stones[/b]
These are both crucial to the storyline as well as act as 'Checkpoints' upon which you can re-enter the cosmos from a certain point. I wont explain how to collect them as it should be pretty obvious, but once you collect them they are 'unlocked' immediately.

[b]Artifacts[/b]
Artifacts are found all over the place, mostly in chests. I wont get too deep into what causes certain ones to appear but basically once you find one you must bring it to someone (spoiler: [spoiler]the old man[/spoiler]). he will basically tell you what the artifact is and unlock it for you, so you can then activate it on the title screen. Artifacts are either 'easy' (green) or 'hard' (red) so they make the game easier or harder depending on which ones you have active and how many. All 24 artifacts are currently findable in the current game. No 2 artifacts should be alike in a single game, but you may find an artifact in a new game that you have already found / unlocked. I did this so that I can spawn a bunch per game without worrying if you have them all or not yet.

Have Fun!

notes.title: OMG Bug Fixes. Build 0.153
notes.notes:
As nuts as this is going to look, this whole damn thing was primarily about bug fixes. I started adding in some dope new stuff, but i didnt want to go too far as it would just delay the update longer. I figure if i can get this to you guys now, you at least have some fixes for the bugs that were in 0.151 while i continue working on the new stuff.

You'll get a hint at what's coming with the Dimensional Stones... those will be how I'm dealing with a lack of save feature. Instead of racking my brains coming up with a way to simply end one game and return to it later, I decided a more permanent solution would be beneficial overall, especially now that I see so clearly that games can last so long. Because of this, I'm introducing the Dimensional Stones. And so... im gonna leave it at that till next time. :) Enjoy the mystery of what is soon to come.

This build also features a cool new idea i've been wanting to do since day one, but after talking to MessedCoast (Tx!!) I really put the pieces together on how i wanted to accomplish it. Basically you now drop a flag on a planet before you start planting seeds on it..... it answers a few issues i was struggling with but most fluffy is the fact that it gives you a reason to call a planet home. Especially now that you can easily find it on a map.

Here's what I did:

[b]Changelog 0.153[/b]
[list]
[*] GAMEPLAY: On powerdown, send the powerup out of your body.
[*] GAMEPLAY: Removed powerups from Vaccuumdragons. the whole point of them giving you powerups was to counterbalance the fact that they easily take them away. now that powerups pop out of you… poof.
[*]  GAMEPLAY: Before you can plant seeds, you must first place a flag.
[*] GAMEPLAY: Placing a flag names the planet.
[*] GAMEPLAY: Made Minimap available by default.
[*] GAMEPLAY: Planets on minimap only show if you've planted a flag. (Starts out empty but can be populated)
[*] GAMEPLAY: “Buying” minimap is now called “Upgrading”.
[*] GAMEPLAY: Upgraded minimap shows unvisited planets. (as it did in all subsequent updates)
[*] GAMEPLAY: However, now you can hover over planets on minimap to show the name.
[*] GAMEPLAY: Upgraded Minimap also shows details on the planets. (Bases on the planet, # of required plants, amount of health available)
[*] CONTROLS: Massive Improvements to Jumping & Jetting.. I hope you like.. feedback welcome as it sort of changes some things up. I got rid of the big gravity changes cuz honestly i feel like it SUCKED.
[*] CONTROLS: Ultranova now can be fast-triggered from F button without using your menu.Open to suggestions on the best key for this if F isnt working.
[*] INTERFACE: Setup interface for super mysterious ultra dimensional time portals.
[*] OCD: Speed up the fading of the title screen transitions.
[*] OCD: Speed up the fading of the pause transition
[*] BUGFIX: Fixed bugs with Navigator NPC.
[*] BUGFIX: Make sure if planet is resized, remove scenery.
[*] BUGFIX: Fixed magical floating helmet on costumes.
[*] STORY: Set name of hermit planet...
[*] BUGFIX: Fixed seeds growing when talking to old man.
[*] BUGFIX: Unable to talk to MacAphelion
[*] BUGFIX: Sword wrong spot on robot.
[*] BUGFIX: Much better Title, Option and Pause screen control. Rewrote from scratch, yo! Works flawlessly with Gamepad now.
[*] BUGFIX: Robot Costume make sure arm is in front of face.
[*] BUGFIX: Set default highlight option when opening menu.
[*] BUGFIX: NInja appearing in space.
[*] BUGFIX: Worm boss not ‘ending’ properly.
[*] BUGFIX: Tejon Towers not working??
[*] BUGFIX: Ninja loses immunity after plant finishes.
[*] BUGFIX: Wrong objects disappeared after bringing numberball to old man. (Sorry Joe, my heart seriously broke when you lost the chunk of metal. O_O )
[*] BUGFIX: Able to swing sword whilst croucheth
[*] Plus a bunch more little bugfixes which i did so fast i forgot to log it. :P
[/list]

[b]GAMEPAD FIXES[/b]
Some important changes were made to how gamepad plays. Honestly, i apologize if this messes with anyone who was used to the old controls, but I really feel this makes more ‘sense’ with jumping / jetting and movement on the left and full gun operations on the right. the key difference too is that the right stick no longer auto-fires since it fundamentally wouldnt work with the plasma weapon or sword which are able to be charged up. 

What i did instead was make it so the right stick simply aims your weapon, and you can fire it using the Right Trigger or Shoulder button. So you can still autofire, it just means you have to hold down the trigger/shoulder button. notes.title: OMG Bug Fixes. Build 0.153
notes.notes:
As nuts as this is going to look, this whole damn thing was primarily about bug fixes. I started adding in some dope new stuff, but i didnt want to go too far as it would just delay the update longer. I figure if i can get this to you guys now, you at least have some fixes for the bugs that were in 0.151 while i continue working on the new stuff.

You'll get a hint at what's coming with the Dimensional Stones... those will be how I'm dealing with a lack of save feature. Instead of racking my brains coming up with a way to simply end one game and return to it later, I decided a more permanent solution would be beneficial overall, especially now that I see so clearly that games can last so long. Because of this, I'm introducing the Dimensional Stones. And so... im gonna leave it at that till next time. :) Enjoy the mystery of what is soon to come.

This build also features a cool new idea i've been wanting to do since day one, but after talking to MessedCoast (Tx!!) I really put the pieces together on how i wanted to accomplish it. Basically you now drop a flag on a planet before you start planting seeds on it..... it answers a few issues i was struggling with but most fluffy is the fact that it gives you a reason to call a planet home. Especially now that you can easily find it on a map.

Respect,

notes.title: Build 0.128 is Live!
notes.notes:
Hey pals, been a good week - lots of tweaks and balance adjustments done to the core mechanics of the game after listening to your feedback and watching lets plays and previews on youtube.. THANKS for being so awesome and giving your feedback and for playing the game on your channels, showing your friends, etc. Your help and feedback is going to make this game even better and I am so grateful for that support! 

Heres a list of what you'll find in the latest build... let me know what you think!

- Changed fire tower to require 2 bases.
- Fixed nomenclature of “Coin Magnet” to “Crystal Magnet”
- Adjusted target point of slimes to help them get hit a little easier (they were meant to be the ‘answer’ to towers and the one thing you need to watch for and kill manually).
- Adjusted Alien ordering so they’d be in front of plants.
- Fade out weapon powerups after 60 seconds. Fadeout lasts 10 seconds so there’s still a chance to grab before it’s gone.

- Changed font. felt like i needed to class it up a bit.

- Disable sword sound / sparks on boss overlapping
- Added ‘prices’ to the action buttons to better help show their costs.
- Make dev mode stop all scoring
- make dev mode cancel all collections
- removed ‘game time’ from game over screen. psychological reasons…
- Made jump button double as jetpack key when already jumping
- Made right click start with a jump before jetting to match key controls
- Fixed collision bump on one of the planets. (was testing and forgot to remove, sorry)
- Updated 'how to play' screen to show new jet/jump controls
- Fixed Z-Ordering/Layering of Sword
- Fixed sword “Drag” when moving really fast.
- Adjusted sword swing animation to start at the angle you hold it at.
- Zoomed out general camera slightly.
- zoomed out boss camera slightly more.
- Adjust robot and turtle shoot rate. Give a cooldown to stop them from spamming.
- Moved quit game button to the left of the pause menu (in game) so it cant be hit accidentally..
- Cheaper Bricks and Ultranovas in the store.
- EVERY hive drops bricks now. (used to be 1 in 5)
- Minor performance improvements and optimizations.
